title: Unbiased Approximate Vector-Jacobian Products for Efficient Backpropagation
abstract: arXiv:2602.14701v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this work we introduce methods to reduce the computational and memory costs of training deep neural networks. Our approach consists in replacing exact vector-jacobian products by randomized, unbiased approximations thereof during backpropagation. We provide a theoretical analysis of the trade-off between the number of epochs needed to achieve a target precision and the cost reduction for each epoch. We then identify specific unbiased estimates of vector-jacobian products for which we establish desirable optimality properties of minimal variance under sparsity constraints. Finally we provide in-depth experiments on multi-layer perceptrons, BagNets and Visual Transfomers architectures. These validate our theoretical results, and confirm the potential of our proposed unbiased randomized backpropagation approach for reducing the cost of deep learning.

translated_title: 用于高效反向传播的无偏近似向量-雅可比积
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们提出了降低深度神经网络训练的计算与内存成本的方法。我们的方法是在反向传播过程中，用随机化的无偏近似来替代精确的向量-雅可比积。我们对达到目标精度所需的训练轮数与每轮成本降低之间的权衡进行了理论分析。随后，我们确定了向量-雅可比积的若干特定无偏估计，并证明了它们在稀疏性约束下具有最小方差的最优性质。最后，我们在多层感知机、BagNets 和视觉 Transformer 等架构上进行了深入实验。这些实验验证了我们的理论结果，并证实了所提出的无偏随机化反向传播方法在降低深度学习成本方面的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出在反向传播中用随机化的无偏近似替代精确的向量-雅可比积，从理论上分析了精度与成本之间的权衡并证明了稀疏约束下最小方差的最优性，实验验证了该方法能有效降低深度学习的训练成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes replacing exact vector-Jacobian products with randomized unbiased approximations during backpropagation, theoretically characterizes the trade-off between precision and cost with minimal-variance optimality under sparsity constraints, and experimentally validates its effectiveness in reducing deep learning training costs.
